explanation: The Almighty Ruler who executes justice through the seven plagues and governs the end of world history.
The heavenly beings who receive God's message to pour out His bowls of wrath upon the earth to punish evil.
The symbol of God's full wrath and judgment, filled with suffering that is poured out over the ungodly nations.
Another term for the bowl, represented as a container holding holy justice against sin.
The painful and grievous sores that strike those who have taken the mark of the beast and worshiped its image.
The evil world system or the figure of the Antichrist who stands in opposition to God and leads people away from the truth.
The false statue of a god or representation of the evil system that demands worship on behalf of the beast.
A sign of loyalty to the evil system, often placed on the right hand or forehead, in contrast to God's seal.
The symbol for chaos and the ungodly nations that are turned into blood during the first plague.
The freshwater resources that also turn to blood, representing judgment upon the foundation of human life.
The intense heat and scorching power from the sun that strikes the ungodly during the sixth plague.
The river whose water is dried up to make way for the kings from the east in the final battle at Armageddon.
The final battle between God's forces and the world's evil powers, taking place on the Hebrew ridge of Megiddo.
The heavenly messenger who has power over light and heat to punish the ungodly.
The sound from the temple in heaven signaling that God's judgment is completed and his rule is established.
The seven final and most severe judgments upon the earth, marking the end of humanity's time for repentance.
